name: RoundUpInvest
concept: Un monogramme minimaliste et structural associant un cercle parfait (symbolisant l'arrondi du 'Round' et la pièce de monnaie) à une diagonale ascendante robuste qui complète la lettre 'R'. L'équilibre géométrique évoque la sécurité d'une institution bancaire traditionnelle alliée à la précision algorithmique de la fintech.

_productList.name: Micro-Growth Ceramic Mug
_productList.design: Minimalist flat vector illustration showing a sequence of three small coins falling into a slot, progressively transforming into a growing green leaf. Clean, professional navy blue and emerald green color palette. Modern sans-serif typography underneath reading 'Small Change, Big Future' in a centered layout.

_productList.name: Compound Interest Tote Bag
_productList.design: Geometric pattern of various sized circles representing rounded-up cents, arranged to form an upward-trending arrow. Flat design style with a professional financial aesthetic. High-contrast white ink on a navy blue canvas, featuring a small 'RoundUpInvest' logo in the bottom right corner.
